title: AI Wars
summary: AI Wars is a single-player trading strategy game for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero.
description:
AI Wars is a single-player trading strategy game for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero. You start in Silicon Valley with $3,000 and a black leather jacket. Stock it with AI hardware, data, and speculative assets, then fly between eight cities and see how much you can make in 30 in-game days.

 Some additional game features:

- 19 commodities to trade (GPUs, H100's, B200's scraped Reddit data and more!).
- 8 cities with unique pricing and trading opportunities.
- many different event types that occur between traveling (mugging, secret stashes, Ram Altman encounters...)
- over 100 news humorous headlines to (hopefully) make you laugh about the current AI industry.
- dozens of quirky family mixups (for good or for worse).
- many different endings entirely based on the success you achieve in the game!
- jacket upgrades, 0day exploits and more to help protect your investments and achieve success!
- auto-save so you can turn off your CP0 whenever you want. Your game will be waiting to continue when you are!
